title: World Reference Map
summary: Static offline world map - country borders, equirectangular projection.
description: A single self-contained SVG world map (country borders, 30-degree lat/lon graticule) - works fully offline, scales cleanly on phone or desktop, no map-tile server or JavaScript mapping library involved. Universal scope: useful anywhere, not tied to this box's location, and shown regardless of Travel Mode or whether Local Information has been configured for this box.
